sum_pos_over_median: Asking is inside the range, {amt} above the median.
sum_pos_under_median: Asking is inside the range, {amt} below the median.
sum_pos_at_median: Asking is at the median of the adjusted comparable sales.

sum_tile_supply: Months of Supply at the Recent Pace of Sales
sum_tile_span: Adjusted Values of the Comparable Sales
sum_comps_h: Comparable Sales, Adjusted to This Home
sum_tax_now: Seller's Tax Bill (What the Listing Shows)
line_costs_note: At {price}{basis}. The assumptions behind these figures are in the notes at the end of the cost section.
line_details: Details, sources and assumptions are in the full analysis that follows.
line_bottom: The median of the comparable sales, adjusted to this home, is {median}.
line_appraisal_gap: An appraisal at the top of the range, {top}, would come in {gap} below asking. A lender lends on the lower of the price and the appraisal, so a financed buyer pays a gap like that in cash or settles it with the seller.
line_range_override: This range is our judgment rather than the standard method's {rule}: {reason}
line_hist_listed: First listed {date}: {days} actively for sale{across}, counting only the days it was for sale, not off the market or under contract.
line_hist_none: No price changes and no failed contracts since then.
line_hist_cut_total: {cuts} totaling {total} ({pct} of the first asking price)
line_hist_last_contract: Asking now is {vs} the {price} it was listed at when it last went under contract.
line_hist_since_sale: The {date} sale and the listings before it are in the table but not in these counts.
hist_relisted: Relisted as a new listing, which reset the day count
hist_back_on_higher: Back on the market at a higher price
hist_back_on_lower: Back on the market at a lower price
line_comps_count: The {n} comparable sales closed from {first} to {last}{since}{within}.
line_set_aside: {address} was set aside: adjusted to {value}, it sat more than 10% {direction} the other sales' median, so the next closest sale took its place.
line_set_aside_alone: {address} was set aside: adjusted to {value}, it sat more than 10% {direction} the other sales' median.
line_kept: {address} is kept although it sits more than 10% {direction} the other sales' median: {reason}
line_roof_unknown: This home's roof age isn't known, so no sale is adjusted for its roof.
line_time_agent: The market adjustment is our own rate rather than the standard method's: {reason}
line_split_override: Recent sales count from {date}, our own choice rather than the standard method's: {reason}
line_comps_within: , all within {dist} miles of this home
line_comps_within_one: , all within a mile of this home
sc_note: Every sale below is adjusted to this home's size, condition, lot, roof and systems.
h_scatter: The Whole Neighborhood at a Glance
line_scatter_intro: Every recent sale and listing in the MLS records from {lo} to {hi} sq ft, plotted by size and price.
line_r2: Size alone explains {share} of the differences in sale prices here; the dashed line shows that size trend, not a value estimate for this home.
trend_head_above: At {price}, this home is asking about {gap} more than its size alone predicts.
trend_head_below: At {price}, this home is asking about {gap} less than its size alone predicts.
trend_head_at: At {price}, this home is asking about what its size alone predicts.
trend_caption: The dashed line shows what homes here sell for based on size alone. Homes above it sold for more, usually because of condition, updates or the lot.
trend_above: Its condition and features have to justify the difference.
trend_below: That can be a good buy or a sign of something the listing doesn't show, so find out which.
excluded_size_one: One home far larger or smaller than this one is left off the chart.
excluded_size_many: {n} homes far larger or smaller than this one are left off the chart.
excluded_price_one: One home priced far from what its size predicts is left off the chart and out of the dashed line.
excluded_price_many: {n} homes priced far from what their size predicts are left off the chart and out of the dashed line.
line_market_intro: {n} sales in the MLS records closed from {first} to {last}. {active} other homes are for sale now{supply}.
line_market_supply: , {months} of supply at the recent pace of sales
h_taxes_higher: Your Tax Bill Will Be Higher than the Listing Shows
line_tax_bill: The listing shows {bill} in taxes for {year}, the current owner's bill.
line_tax_bill_no_year: The listing shows {bill} in taxes, the current owner's bill.
line_tax_no_bill: The listing shows no current tax bill for this home.
line_tax_resets: In {state}, a home's taxable value resets when it sells, so your bill will be based on roughly what you pay.
line_tax_homestead: You can file for your own homestead exemption.
your_bill: Your Bill if the Home Is {label}
line_escrow: Your lender will likely set up your escrow using the seller's lower bill. When your own bill arrives, your monthly payment can rise to cover the difference. Budget for your own bill from the start.
line_pay_intro: {n} ways to finance this home, at a {rate} 30-year fixed rate{week}. Your lender will give you exact numbers.
line_pay_intro_one: One way to finance this home, at a {rate} 30-year fixed rate{week}. Your lender will give you exact numbers.
line_per10k: Every $10,000 off the price lowers the payment by about {amt} a month.
pay_bb: Buyer's Broker Fee (Not Paid by Seller)
note_national_rates: The {kinds} adjustments use national estimates scaled to these sales' prices, since no local rates are built in for this area; paired sales or your own rates replace them.
note_financing_assumed: The {labels} financing is assumed until the buyer's lender confirms it.
note_financing_assumed_some: The financing in the {labels} columns is assumed until the buyer's lender confirms it.
note_financing_assumed_all: The financing in every payment column is assumed until the buyer's lender confirms it.
note_insurance_est: Homeowners insurance is estimated at {amt} a year for this home's price and age; it isn't a quote. Get a real quote during the inspection period.
note_insurance_given: Homeowners insurance uses {amt} a year, the figure given for this home.
note_mi_pmi: private mortgage insurance of about {rate} a year at {down} down (less with more down, none from 20%)
note_mi_fha: FHA mortgage insurance of {rate} a year with the {upfront} upfront premium added to the loan
note_mi_va: the VA funding fee of {upfront} added to the loan
note_mi_usda: USDA's annual fee of {rate} with the {upfront} upfront guarantee fee added to the loan
note_mi: Payments assume {parts}: estimates by down payment, not loan quotes.
note_closing_est: Closing costs are estimated at about {pct} of the price{prepaids}{taxes}, until the lender's Loan Estimate.
note_closing_given: Closing costs are {pct} of the price, as given.
note_closing_lender: Closing costs for {label} are the lender's estimate of {amt}{others}.
note_closing_lender_others: ; the other columns use about {pct} of the price{prepaids}{taxes}
note_credit_limits: A seller credit can only pay actual closing costs, prepaid items and escrows; any part above those costs is lost, and it can never be taken as cash. Loan programs limit seller contributions: conventional 3% of price below 10% down, 6% at 10–25% down, 9% at 25% or more; FHA 6%; VA 4% in concessions plus normal closing costs. Confirm with your lender.
note_cash: Cash available for the down payment and closing: about {cash}.
note_bb: The buyer's broker agreement is {agreement} of the price and the seller pays {seller}, so the difference counts in cash to close.
note_tax_rate: No millage for this area yet: the tax is estimated at about {pct} of the price. Confirm it with the property appraiser.
note_tax_rate_state: No millage for this area yet: the tax is estimated at about {pct} of the price, the state's average effective rate. Confirm it with the property appraiser.
note_tax_assessed: Tax estimates assume the county values the home at the purchase price; it often values homes somewhat lower, so treat them as the high end. Flat assessments (garbage and other non-ad valorem charges) aren't included.
note_tax_portability: Portability isn't included: a buyer leaving a homestead in this state may carry part of its capped difference, which can lower the first bills (ask the property appraiser).
note_tax_which_higher: The parcel's taxing district isn't confirmed: the payment uses the {short} bill, the higher of the two, until it is.
note_tax_which: The parcel's taxing district isn't confirmed: the payment uses the {short} bill until it is.
line_sources_export: Sales: {n} closed sales from {first} to {last}, plus {listings}, from MLS records.
line_sources_listings: {active} active, {pending} pending and {ended} expired or canceled listings
line_shelf_life: Market conditions change, so refresh this analysis if it is more than a few weeks old.
